headlines.title: Keurig's U.S. Beverage Sales Rise 10.9%: Can This Momentum Last?
headlines.summary: KDP's U.S. Refreshment Beverages sales increase 10.9% as Dr Pepper, GHOST and Electrolit fuel growth and energy share expands.

headlines.title: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Split Plan
headlines.summary: The fair value estimate for Keurig Dr Pepper has shifted modestly higher to US$38.82 from US$36.97, pointing to a small adjustment in the underlying valuation work. This move comes as analysts weigh confidence in the beverage and coffee franchises against questions around the planned split into Global Coffee Co and Beverage Co, which is tightening the range of price views.

headlines.title: Return your empties. Reject the closure of local bottle depots
headlines.summary: The BC Bottle and Recycling Depot Association (BCBRDA), representing BC's independent depots, is launching Reject-It.ca to challenge underpayment and threatened closures.

headlines.title: 3 Food and Beverage Dividend Stocks to Buy in December for Reliable Income
headlines.summary: One grocery-aisle giant has mailed dividend checks for 127 straight years, while another has not given shareholders a raise since 2019. Before you lock in a December income pick, see which payout is safest and which one quietly erodes.

headlines.title: iShares Core S&P 500 (IVV) Buys $74.7 Million More Apple on Nov. 16
headlines.summary: The fund added $952.6 million across 498 positions and sold nothing, with Apple, Microsoft and Nvidia leading the buys.

description: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. owns, manufactures, and distributors beverages and single serve brewing systems in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. It manufactures and distributes branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, as well as sales of owned brands and third-party brands; tea, cocoa, and other products; and offers finished goods relating to K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, specialty coffee, and ready to drink coffee products. The company offers its products under the Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, Snapple, 7UP, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, Core Hydration, The Original Donut Shop, Sunkist soda, Squirt, C4 Energy, Hawaiian Punch, Electrolit, Bloom, Bai, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Vita Coco, Big Red, RC Cola, Crush, McCafé, Tim Hortons, Van Houtte, Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, Starbucks, Dunkin', Folgers, Peet's, and Swiss Miss brands, as well as other partner and private label brands. It markets and sells its products to supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, e-commerce retailers, office superstores, vending machines, fountains, grocery and drug stores, convenience stores, and other small outlets; and directly to consumers through Keurig.com website. Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas.
